reviews.comment: Dr. Reese is a great lecturer, and his lectures are very detailed and filled with information. He is very experienced and knows what he's doing. However, he is also a very tough grader. He gives good feedback but you have to work really hard to consistently get As. Don't take this class as a blow-off class; you have to be interested to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Reese is a great lecturer. All of the information you need for his class are presented in his detailed lectures. But, he is a pretty tough grader. He gives good feedback overall, but there weren't any rubrics or criteria on what he was looking for. This is a writing-only class, and there are tons of reading to do as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures themselves weren't bad at all. He was funny, and knowledgeable about the topic. However, the class felt way too difficult for a freshman-level class. Essays on textbooks would be 10+ pages, electronic devices were not allowed, and he was a very tough grader. His slideshows helped a ton, paying attention is mandatory.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Too difficult for a freshman level course avoid at all cost
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Class is solely slideshow lectures with slides that are pretty light. Lectures themselves are essentially like a history podcast with a few funny comments thrown in, I found the lectures themselves to be pretty good. Notes are only pencil and paper, although I think tablets were allowed. Writing assignments aren't to bad just follow instructions.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are amazing, and he has a great sense of humor, but he is a VERY tough grader on the writing assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: This was the first class where I actually had to learn how to study. Dr. Reese is the most difficult History professor I've ever had as he has high expectations for his students. However he is very accessible, gives great feedback to guide you in the right direction, and is genuinely a great lecturer who is truly passionate. Also extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He was one of the best professors I had at A&M. He was very stern but genuinely a great teacher and taught in a way where anyone could learn. Attendance is mandatory but if you come you get extra credit points. I hate going to class and had no problem going to his because it was actually interesting! Had a few book reports so be ready to read!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The most unfair thing about the Dr. Reese's lecture is the gap between the class and the exam. When I asked him seriously for advice, he didn't take it seriously. When I personally asked if I could pass above C, he said yes, but he gave me a D. Even though it's been years since I graduated, but it still remains a big scar on my chest.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I didn't think I was going to enjoy the topic at first, but Dr. Reese made it so fun! The papers that you'll have to write are very extensive, and the books are a lot, but it's worth it! Going to lecture is STRONGLY suggested. Dr. Reese cares about the topic so much that it so fun to go to lecture, and is my favorite prof I've ever had.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Who knew European history could be so dull! Not a hard class but narrow in focus and taught by a prof who was more interesting in telling than discussing. Seems like he taught this class a million times.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Reese is both one of the best profs I've ever had and the hardest. If you are not a History Major, I would not recommend taking him. He assigns a TON of reading and writing, and grades fairly hard. While he is challenging, he is also an amazing teacher. He helps you to hone your skills as a historian like no other. I have had him for 4 courses.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Honestly, the only reason he's still here is that he has tenure. I know of 2 professors here that took his class and Q-Dropped it when they were an undergrad. His class is unnecessarily hard, and he's even bragged to others in the dept about how many students Q-Drop. Don't waste your time. Take someone else. Literally anyone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Reese is really amazing. He knows his stuff, his lectures are pretty fun, and he's a really impressive guy. However, its a hard class! Don't plan on getting an A even if you're an A student. Don't take this class unless you don't have any other hard classes and really have the time to put in. I loved this class and enjoyed it, but it's rough.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Reese has good lectures, but papers and exams are graded harshly, especially in the first half of the semester. 25% drop rate is his average for this class. Overall the class is good but definitely not an easy A or B.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Reese is an awesome lecturer. He is very specific and you can easily tell he loves to teach about WW2. But, DO NOT take this class if you aren't willing to sacrifice personal time. The book assignments only get longer as the semester goes on and if you don't read you won't pass. You've been warned
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Class is all lecture so don't skip. Take detailed notes & study hard bc he is very particular about essay test answers. Gives extra credit if you have perfect attendance! Get ready to write long essays in this class. He's intimidating but extremely smart and really funny! I really respect him, but Idk if I could take his class again- tough stuff :)
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Each class is a full oral lecture and there are no notes online. Computers are not allowed in class and handwritten notes usually take up to 4 pages so be prepared to write fast. Exams are specific multiple choice and essays average 10 pages. This class requires daily studying or your gpa WILL suffer. Hes a nice guy tho and really enjoys teaching.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great lecture, literally wrote the book on the USSR. As awesome as the material and lectures are, your GPA is going to take a hit with this one. I'm an "A's" with a couple "B's" student and I had to Q drop. Whatever he was looking for on his essay exams I kept missing the mark. A's are possible, but only if you live and breath History papers.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: This needs to be heavily emphasized: ONLY take Reeses classes if you REALLY want to learn the subject. You cannot casually get by in his classes. If you do a lot of activities outside of class - hobbies , friends, Corps etc - then dont take his class, because you wont have time. Dont believe the hype; sure, he can be funny, but the work load...
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Reese gives engaging lectures and is helpful outside of class if needed. He does grade pretty tough on the tests, which are all essay, but with proper notes you can do well. He is the professor to take if you actually want to learn the subject, not an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Reese was a really great professor, and I loved the subject! He is an extremely tough grader, but by showing up every day you receive 10 extra points so that's incentive enough. Plus he strictly lectures so it's important to show up. Overall take this professor if you really wanna learn the subject, not if you want an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I had the privilege of having Dr. Reese for Russian History. Though the tests and term paper were very labor intensive, the class itself was very fun. Russian History in itself is hilarious, but Dr. Reese was able to deliver the class with solid lectures, was very knowledgeable on the material, and was humorous all throughout. Very approachable.

Some of his lectures are entertaining, and some are very boring. Must go to class to pass! The test has an essay question over lecture, a book question, and 5 define questions. He grades really hard, and you must put exactly what he wants or you won't get credit. He gives study guides but the questions on the test are way more detailed.
His lectures were very entertaining and he is very knowledgeable, but good lord he is a tough grader!

One of my favorite classes ever at A&M! If you go to class, take good notes, & read the assigned books, you'll be fine. Dr. Reese's lectures are great & I loved how straightforward & funny he was. I'd definitely recommend, but only if you actually like history- you'll have to know the specific content & actually go to class to do well.

Attendance is mandatory in order for you to pass. He doesn't use any visual aid and just lectures straight through. As long as you take notes throughout the entire class, the time will go by fast. You will not pass the class if you don't take notes because his take home exams come straight through your notes. Easily passable if you put in effort.

He changes his exams every major exam from multiple choice, to essays, or both. He grades very harshly on essays. He is somewhat helpful. Skip class and you will fail though. The TA was more helpful than him and helped me get a good grade.

Dr. Reese's lecture are awesome! They are so entertaining and he offers incentives for attending. His tests are straight forward and with minimal brain power you can figure out what he is going to test you over. He is super picky about his term paper but its an easy rubric to follow.
His lectures were awesome and rather entertaining, but his tests were evil!
